item.title: Chiefs remain unbeaten, control winless Chargers,
item.description: Kenneth Walker III rushed for 128 yards and two touchdowns and Patrick Mahomes passed for 272 yards to boost the host Kansas City Chiefs to a 22-6 victory against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kenneth Walker III rushed for 128 yards and two touchdowns and Patrick Mahomes passed for 272 yards to boost the host Kansas City Chiefs to a 22-6 victory against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday. Kansas City improved to 5-0 to remain the lone unbeaten team in the AFC. The skidding Chargers (0-6) are off to the franchise's worst start since the 2000 San Diego Chargers lost their first 11 games during a 1-15 season. Los Angeles coach Jim Harbaugh started five games at quarterback for that team. Cameron Dicker kicked field goals of 23 and 30 yards for the Chargers. Los Angeles drove to the Kansas City 1-yard line on the first possession of the second half but settled for a Dicker kick after a holding penalty stalled the drive. Kansas City's Harrison Butker was good from 30 yards with 3:52 to play for the Chiefs' only points of the second half. Mahomes was 23-for-30 through the air while earning his 100th win as a starting quarterback. The Chiefs sacked Chargers QB Justin Herbert four times, matching their season total entering the game. Los Angeles had three turnovers on downs. Kansas City rolled to a 9-0 lead midway through the first quarter. Los Angeles limited Kansas City to a 44-yard Butker field goal on the game's opening drive. The Chargers punted on their first possession, and the Chiefs responded with a six-play, 67-yard touchdown drive. Walker scored on a 33-yard run up the middle with 7:21 to go in the quarter. The Chargers answered with a 23-yard Dicker field goal after driving 60 yards in 11 plays. Herbert connected with Ladd McConkey for 17 yards on the first play of the drive but McConkey was evaluated for a concussion after taking a hit near midfield. McConkey was ruled out with a concussion late in the second quarter. He missed the previous game against the Denver Broncos with a foot injury. The teams traded interceptions in the second quarter, with Jack Cochrane snagging a pick of Herbert before the Chargers' Cam Hart intercepted Mahomes. Kansas City forced a Los Angeles punt and seized control with Walker's 2-yard touchdown run with 1:49 to go before halftime. Mahomes was 5-for-5 for 65 yards on the drive and added a run of 10 yards. Butker kicked a 50-yard field goal just before time expired on the second quarter as the Chiefs took a 19-3 advantage at halftime. Herbert was 22-for-37 for 204 yards and an interception. He also led Los Angeles with 26 yards on five carries. Xavier Worthy had seven catches for 73 yards for the Chiefs. Kansas City cornerback Christian Roland-Wallace was ejected early in the fourth quarter for throwing a punch against Chargers right tackle Alex Harkey. --Field Level Media

item.title: リトアニア上空でウクライナ無人機爆発か、ＮＡＴＯが緊急発進
item.description:
Andrius Sytas
[ビリニュス １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrius Sytas

[ビリニュス １８日 ロイター] - バルト３国のリトアニアで１８日、領空に侵入した無人機（ドローン）とみられる物体が上空で爆発した。警報が発令され、北部と中部で住民が１時間にわたり避難した。ナウセーダ大統領や国防当局者が明らかにした。

ウクライナ外務省はその後、ロシアの電波妨害でドローンが進路から外れた可能性があるとして遺憾の意を示した。

ナウセーダ大統領は「ロシアによるウクライナ侵略戦争が北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）と欧州連合（ＥＵ）の東側側面にまで波及している」とＸに投稿した。

カウナス国防相は、物体がポーランドから侵入したと述べ、同国に共同調査を要請。ポーランド側は、物体がリトアニアへ越境したことはレーダーで確認できていないとした。

ＮＡＴＯの指揮下にあるイタリアの戦闘機２機が緊急発進したが、曇天で物体を目視確認できず、撃墜は試みなかった。リトアニア第２の都市、中部カウナス近郊にあるカナウス空港も一時閉鎖された。軍は北部で残骸とみられる物体を調べており、一部は民間車両に当たったという。

ここ数カ月、バルト海地域ではウクライナのドローンがＮＡＴＯ加盟国の領空に繰り返し侵入。ウクライナ側はロシアの電波妨害が原因と説明しており、懸念が強まっている。

item.title: Australia's Cleanaway agrees to $6.5 billion EQT takeover, shares surge
item.description: Cleanaway Waste Management said on Monday it had agreed to be bought by Swedish private equity group EQT in a deal valuing the Australian waste management company at about A$9.3 billion ($6.5 billion), including debt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cleanaway Waste Management (CWY.AX) said on Monday it had agreed to be bought by Swedish private equity group EQT (EQTAB.ST) in a deal valuing the Australian waste management company at about A$9.3 billion ($6.5 billion), including debt. Here are some more details: Shares of Cleanaway rose nearly 20% to A$2.960, set for their best day since October, 2011 Under the terms of the deal, Cleanaway shareholders will receive A$3.095 in cash for each share held, less the cash amount of any dividends paid before completion of the transaction The consideration reflects EQT's indicative offer of A$3.13 per share, adjusted for Cleanaway's final dividend paid on October 8 Cleanaway said the A$3.13 offer values the company at about A$9.3 billion, including debt, and represents a 32.1% premium to its closing share price on August 12, the last trading day before EQT's approach was disclosed Cleanaway said its board unanimously recommends shareholders vote in favour of the scheme implementation deed, in the absence of a superior proposal The firm said it may pay aggregate cash dividends of up to A$0.19 per share before implementation, including a fully franked special dividend. Any dividends paid will be deducted from the scheme consideration [USN:L4N4491P9 TEXT:"In August"], the Melbourne-based waste solutions provider had granted exclusive due diligence to EQT Infrastructure, managed by Swedish investment firm EQT

item.title: Driver released after pickup truck kills 2, injures 10 at Kansas youth soccer game
item.description: The woman who was driving a pickup truck that entered a Kansas soccer field during a youth match, killing a man and 6-year-old boy, was released without charges while the investigation continues, authorities said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Maria Tsvetkova
item.content:encoded: The woman who was driving a pickup truck that entered a Kansas soccer field during a youth match, [USN:SPN45Y0Z2 TEXT:"killing a man and 6-year-old"] boy, was released without charges while the investigation continues, authorities said on Sunday. Investigators interviewed the 34-year-old woman, whom authorities have not publicly identified, and consulted with the Sedgwick County district attorney's office before releasing her, the Wichita Police Department said in a statement. Police said toxicology testing and a mechanical examination of the vehicle were still under way. The Chevrolet pickup truck had been parked near a soccer field in Wichita on Saturday before entering the pitch during a game and striking multiple people, police said. Five children ages 5 to 9 and five adults suffered noncritical injuries, police said. Two children of the driver were inside the truck when the incident occurred and were interviewed, police said. One of the driver's children was playing on a different soccer field at the complex, according to the police statement. Wichita police will present an initial review of the case to the district attorney early this week, district attorney's office spokesperson Lyndsee Stover said in an email. Police identified those killed in the crash as 6-year-old Cole Adrian and 35-year-old Nicholas Schafer of McPherson, Kansas. "Our hearts are with the families of Adrian and Nicholas as they face an unimaginable loss. What should have been a day of children playing soccer and families spending time together ended in tragedy," Wichita Police Chief Joe Sullivan said.

item.title: ＡＩ能力向上で米ＧＤＰは2030年に50%増も＝アンソロピック幹部
item.description:
David Lawder
[バンコク １７日 ロイター] - 米生成人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの共同創業者...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ能力向上で米ＧＤＰは2030年に50%増も＝アンソロピック幹部 8:39 配信

アンソロピック共同創設者のジャック・クラーク氏。10月16日、タイのバンコクで撮影。 REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

David Lawder

[バンコク １７日 ロイター] - 米生成人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの共同創業者で公共政策部門トップを務めるジャック・クラーク氏は１７日、タイの首都バンコクで開かれた国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行年次総会の関連会合で講演し、ＡＩの能力向上により、あらゆる分野で変化のスピードが大幅に加速するとの認識を示した。

クラーク氏は同社の社内モデルによる試算として、一定の条件下で米国の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）が２０３０年までに現在の３０兆ドル超から約４４兆ドルへほぼ５０％増加する可能性があると説明した。またＡＩが科学的発見を大幅に加速させていると指摘した。試算はＡＩ技術が今後も進歩し続けることを前提としており、大幅な経済成長が実現する場合には、その成長を支える新産業や新たな発明が生まれる必要があるとの見方を示した。

一方でＡＩがもたらす変革に対応するため、各国による国際協調の下で「異例かつ厳格なルール」を整備する必要があると強調し、政策当局が対応できる時間は限られていると警鐘を鳴らした。クラーク氏はＡＩ開発の速度が人間の管理能力を上回る「シンギュラリティー（技術的特異点）」の兆候が強まっていると述べた上で「今後数年間でＡＩだけでなく科学全体の進歩のペースが加速するだろう。それは混乱や戸惑いを生む一方で、大きな富と重大なリスクをもたらす可能性がある」と付け加えた。

ＩＭＦ・世界銀行会合では、ＡＩが高エネルギー価格の影響を補う成長要因になるとの期待が示された半面、生産性向上効果が期待外れに終わった場合や関連銘柄の株価が急落した場合の金融安定への影響を懸念する声も上がった。雇用の喪失や、一部の国がＡＩ革命から取り残されることへの不安も示された。

これに対してクラーク氏は、ＡＩが数学、工学、生物学などの研究を支援し、新薬開発を含む科学的発見を加速させると予想するとともに、研究者が数百から数千のＡＩアシスタントに支援されることで、科学研究の生産性が高まると述べた。

さらにＡＩの稼働に必要なデータセンター整備に各国が関与することで、より多くの国がＡＩ革命に参加できるとの考えも明らかにした。

ただＡＩの高度化は生物兵器やサイバー兵器など科学技術の悪用につながる恐れもあると警告し、「ＡＩを科学に活用できることは、科学の悪用にも道を開く。私たちは多くの選択を迫られている」とくぎを刺した。

特に生物学研究についてはＡＩが既に新たなウイルスを生み出している点に触れて「最も厳格な人的監督と透明性を確保する必要がある」と強調した。

最近ＡＩが試験環境を抜け出したり、ウェブサイトやデータベースに侵入したりする事例も報告されている問題についてクラーク氏は「現時点ではなお人間が管理している」と語りながらも、安全対策を導入するための猶予は「あと数年程度」に縮小しているとの認識を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/19(月) 8:39 ロイター

item.title: 中国、ＩＭＦによる主要先進国財政リスク監視強化支持 人民銀総裁
item.description:
Selena Li
［バンコク １７日 ロイター］ - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁は１７日、国際通貨基金...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国、ＩＭＦによる主要先進国財政リスク監視強化支持　人民銀総裁 8:34 配信

中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁。2024年9月、北京で撮影。 REUTERS/Tingshu Wang/File Photo

Selena Li

［バンコク　１７日　ロイター］ - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）の潘功勝総裁は１７日、国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）が「主要先進国」の財政リスクとその波及効果に対する監視を強めることを、中国は支持すると表明した。国際通貨金融委員会（ＩＭＦＣ）会合で述べた。

人民銀の声明によると、潘氏はＩＭＦに対し、世界的な不均衡を分析するとともに、資本フローなどの金融要因が不均衡に与える影響をより重視するよう求めた。その上で、中国は多国間貿易体制を支持し、あらゆる形の保護主義的措置に反対すると述べた。

ＩＭＦのゲオルギエワ専務理事は１４日、中国は輸出主導型の成長から、より内需主導型の成長へと転換しなければならないと述べた。

item.title: Australia's Ampol third-quarter Lytton refining margin more than doubles
item.description: Australia's Ampol reported a 125% rise in third-quarter refining margins at its Lytton refinery on Monday while lowering its expected output of higher-value products at the refinery for the fourth quarter, reflecting advanced maintenance work.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's Ampol (ALD.AX) reported a 125% rise in third-quarter refining margins at its Lytton refinery on Monday while lowering its expected output of higher-value products at the refinery for the fourth quarter, reflecting advanced maintenance work. Australia's top fuel retailer said its Lytton refining margin increased to $23.92 per barrel for the third quarter, from $10.64 per barrel a year ago. Supply disruptions due to conflict in the Middle East boosted its refinery margins and continue to be a net favourable for Ampol's integrated supply chain. Ampol said it identified a need for additional maintenance work during an inspection of Lytton's Fluidised Catalytic Cracking Unit. Maintenance work is expected to lower its production of gasoline, diesel and jet fuel by 150 million litres in the fourth quarter compared with its previous outlook. Total group sales volume was 6,245 million litres for the third quarter, up from 6,028 million litres a year earlier.

item.title: Tyler Reddick uses bold move to win Freeway Insurance 500
item.description: Tyler Reddick had to take his No. 45 Toyota to the Arizona desert to end his thirst for victory.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tyler Reddick had to take his No. 45 Toyota to the Arizona desert to end his thirst for victory. The 23XI Racing driver made a two-tire stop on the final pit stop, completed a bold four-wide move on a restart and returned to Victory Lane by winning Sunday afternoon's Freeway Insurance 500 at Phoenix Raceway in Avondale, Ariz. In earning his NASCAR Cup Series-leading sixth win, Reddick passed Chase Briscoe with 18 laps to go and pulled away to beat polesitter Ryan Blaney by 0.801 seconds. It was Reddick's first win at the 1-mile track and the 14th of his career. "We wanted to be a lot better when we came back here, and I think we checked that box," said Reddick, who led 18 laps and last won April 19 at Kansas. "This group never lost its motivation or its drive. We kept searching and trying to find ways to make ourselves and all-around better team. ... I had a really good feeling today. "I didn't have a good launch (on the final restart), but there was a hole, and I was able to get through it." Blaney, Chase Elliott, Christopher Bell and Corey Heim rounded out the top five. Points leader Kyle Larson had an accident late and finished 34th, while Denny Hamlin had a flat tire and a penalty and placed 28th. "Not a good one," Larson said of his showing in the six-caution race. "I was just trying to salvage anything. A top-20 would've been great. I just blew a right front. A lot of people were." Larson leads Bell by six points, with Briscoe 24 points back, Hamlin 31 back and Blaney 40 back to round out the top five in the standings. Running near the back of the top 20 on the flat oval, Riley Herbst and Michael McDowell wrecked to bring out the first caution. The ensuing pit stops ended with Hamlin taking two tires and leading Hendrick Motorsports drivers William Byron and Elliott off pit road. Joey Logano easily won the stage, while Hamlin, Bell, Blaney and Briscoe collected the descending bonus points. After taking two tires and restarting fifth, Larson's No. 5 Chevrolet crossed the line in 22nd. Hamlin gradually worked his way forward to just outside the top 10, while two-time Cup Series champion Larson continued to slide during Stage 2's 125 laps. Larson lost a lap and ran 28th as the race neared the midpoint. Logano won the race off pit road after Austin Dillon's wreck and maintained a solid lead over Briscoe en route to a 1-2 finish in Stage 2. Bell, Josh Berry and Bubba Wallace followed in stage points, while Larson ran 27th but managed to remain on the lead lap. Logano, a three-time series champion, led as the final stretch began but soon complained of a vibration as Wallace cut into his advantage. Running fourth, Hamlin's No. 11 Toyota cut a right rear tire on Lap 221, forcing him to pit under green. He was then caught speeding. Cody Ware immediately wrecked after a tire problem, putting Hamlin a lap down. Wallace was first off pit road and led by 1.3 seconds when he pitted with 43 laps remaining, handing the lead to Briscoe. Larson suffered a flat tire and hit the wall with about 30 laps remaining, bringing out the final caution, while Wallace was penalized for speeding. --Field Level Media

item.title: ゴルフ＝竹田は4位、原と吉田10位 ビュイックＬＰＧＡ
item.description: ［１８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１８日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのビュイックＬＰＧＡは１８日、中国・上海の佘山国際ＧＣ（パー７２）で最終ラウンドを行い、竹田麗央は４位で大会を終えた。

４位で出た竹田は４バーディー、１ボギーの３アンダー６９で回り、通算７アンダーの２８１だった。前日１４位の原英莉花は５バーディー、２ボギーの６９をマークし、通算２アンダーの２８６で１０位に浮上した。

９位スタートの吉田優利も２アンダー７０で回り、通算２アンダーで１０位となった。西郷真央は２６位、勝みなみは４１位だった。

殷若寧（中国）が５バーディー、１ボギーの４アンダー６８で回り、通算１１アンダーの２７７で逆転優勝を果たした。今季２勝目、ツアー通算７勝目。

item.title: サッカー＝久保が1得点1アシスト、ソシエダード大勝 レアルも快勝
item.description: ［マドリード １８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［マドリード　１８日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は１８日、各地で試合を行い、久保建英が所属するレアル・ソシエダードは敵地でマラガに５─２で大勝した。先発出場した久保は１得点１アシストを記録した。

久保は前半３分、右サイドでパスを受けると、そのまま持ち運んでカットインから左足でゴール左上にシュートを決めて先制点を奪った。

さらに２─１で迎えた後半１４分には、同じく右サイドで攻撃を仕掛け、ミケル・オヤルサバルのゴールをアシスト。ソシエダードはその後、再び１点差に詰め寄られたものの、同２２分にオヤルサバルがこの日２点目を挙げ、同２８分にはゴンサロ・ゲデスが加点して突き放した。

得点もアシストも今季初だった久保は後半２６分までプレーした。

レアル・マドリードはホームでセビリアに４─１で快勝。前半３０分にアルダ・ギュレルがペナルティーエリア外から先制点を決めると、同３７分にはキリアン・エムバペが追加点を挙げた。

エムバペは後半１８分にも自ら獲得したＰＫを決めて２得点を記録。レアルは同３５分に１点を返されたが、その２分後に突き放した。レアルは勝ち点２１で３位に浮上し、首位バルセロナとの勝ち点６差を維持した。

item.title: カナダ軍基地で火災、4人死亡39人負傷 強風で延焼
item.description:
Amanda Stephenson
[カルガリー（カナダ） １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Amanda Stephenson

[カルガリー（カナダ） １８日 ロイター] - カナダ西部アルバータ州のウェインライト軍基地で１７日に火災が発生し、兵士少なくとも４人が死亡し、１９人が重体となっている。部隊が訓練していた演習場で発生した火が燃え広がったという。

当局によると、火災は１７日午後４時ごろに発生。訓練区域内の草地で出火し、その後強風にあおられて延焼した。３９人が病院に搬送された。

カーニー首相は１８日、火災について、カナダ軍が平時に国内で経験した中でも最悪レベルの惨事だと述べた。基地には、陸軍の訓練や演習を実施する機動訓練センターがあり、被害に遭った隊員らは全国の基地から集まっていたという。

国勢調査のデータによると、同基地には２０２１年時点で軍人と文民職員計１３１０人が勤務していた。マクギンティ国防相は現地に入り、状況の説明を受けると述べた。

item.title: Chad Ryland's sixth FG is a winner as Cardinals edge Rams
item.description: The Arizona Cardinals received a career-best six field goals from Chad Ryland, including the game winner from 43 yards as time expired, to earn an 18-16 victory over the Los Angeles Rams on Sunday at Inglewood, Calif.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Arizona Cardinals received a career-best six field goals from Chad Ryland, including the game winner from 43 yards as time expired, to earn an 18-16 victory over the Los Angeles Rams on Sunday at Inglewood, Calif. Jacoby Brissett completed 24 of 35 passes for 218 yards with an interception, while leading the Cardinals on a game-winning 40-yard scoring drive in the closing minute. Bam Knight rushed for 80 yards on 15 carries for Arizona (2-4), which had 338 yards of total offense to 286 for the Rams. The Cardinals won for the second time this season in the Los Angeles area after a Week 1 road victory over the Chargers. Matthew Stafford completed 25 of 33 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns but struggled to get the Rams offense going against a blitzing Cardinals defense. Puka Nacua had six receptions for 80 yards for Los Angeles (2-4). While Ryland was the star for the Cardinals, the Rams lost new kicker Blake Grupe in the first quarter when he injured his knee on a kickoff and did not return. The Rams got on the scoreboard first with a 44-yard field goal from Grupe with 9:41 left in the first quarter. Grupe was signed after Harrison Mevis was released after missing two field goals in an overtime loss Monday to the Buffalo Bills. On the ensuing kickoff, Grupe was injured making a tackle on Devin Duvernay and did not return. The Cardinals pushed in front 6-3 on consecutive field goals from Ryland, including the second from 30 yards early in the second quarter. The Rams went on a 12-play, 73-yard drive in the second quarter that ended on a 15-yard TD pass from Stafford to Blake Corum. But Stafford was sacked on a two-point conversion attempt as the Rams were left with a 9-6 lead. Arizona tied the score 9-9 on a 22-yard field goal from Ryland late in the first half and went up 12-9 on a 38-yarder midway through the third quarter. Ryland made it 15-9 with 9:28 remaining after a 27-yard field goal. The Rams went ahead 16-15 with 47 seconds remaining on a 6-yard TD reception from Colby Parkinson. Punter Ethan Evans made the extra point. The key to the Cardinals' game-winning drive was a 21-yard pass to Jalen Brooks and a 15-yard personal foul penalty on the Rams at the end of the play. --Field Level Media

item.title: Florida State RB Ousmane Kromah (ankle) undergoes season-ending surgery
item.description: Florida State running back Ousmane Kromah will miss the rest of the season after sustaining a serious left ankle injury during the Seminoles' double-overtime loss at then-No. 3 Miami on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Florida State running back Ousmane Kromah will miss the rest of the season after sustaining a serious left ankle injury during the Seminoles' double-overtime loss at then-No. 3 Miami on Saturday night. The school said Kromah underwent surgery in Miami before returning to Tallahassee on Sunday. Kromah was injured during a second-quarter carry near the Hurricanes' end zone. He tried to hop off the field on his right foot before falling to the turf. An air cast was placed on the leg and Kromah was carted off the field. Kromah had 44 yards on 14 carries before exiting. "I just love the kid," Florida State coach Mike Norvell said after the 43-35 setback. "Just to see somebody that's hurting the way that he was hurting, you know, he's such a competitor. He's tough. Even with (the injury), he's hopping to get across (the field). I just went out there and I just told him, ‘Look at me.' I said, ‘Everything's going to be OK. Whatever it is, it'll all be good.'" Kromah ranks 20th nationally with 609 rushing yards. The sophomore has scored five touchdowns. Kromah rushed for 408 yards last season as a freshman. Florida State (3-4, 1-3 Atlantic Coast Conference) has a bye next week before hosting Clemson on Oct. 31. --Field Level Media

item.title: イラン国会、新国防相を承認 米の再攻撃に「大規模な反撃」警告
item.description: ［ドバイ １８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ドバイ　１８日　ロイター］ - イラン国会は１８日、メフルダード・アフラギ・ケタブチ氏の国防軍需相就任を承認した。前任のナシルザデ氏が、２月末の米国とイスラエルによる攻撃で死亡し、マジド・エブン・アル・レザ氏が国防相代行を務めていた。

アフラギ氏は、防衛産業に数十年携わり、航空宇宙部門やミサイル部門で要職を歴任した。米国と欧州連合（ＥＵ）の制裁対象となっている。

アフラギ氏は国会で、国の軍需産業インフラの再建、防衛技術開発の加速、民間企業との協力拡大を表明した。また、米国がイランに対して「全ての爆弾の母」を使う可能性に備え、イラン政府は必要な対抗措置を講じたと説明した。

ＣＮＮは１５日、米軍が、トランプ米大統領がイランへの戦闘作戦再開を命じた場合に備え、同国のエネルギーインフラや核施設に対し、大規模爆風爆弾（ＭＯＡＢ）「ＧＢＵ─４３／Ｂ」を使用する可能性を含む攻撃計画を策定したと伝えた。

アフラギ氏は「米国という敵が再び誤算を犯せば、勇敢なイラン国民とイスラムの戦士による反撃は驚くべき大規模なものになる」とし、「米大統領は、自国部隊をわれわれの地域から安全に撤退させることに注力すべきだ。爆弾を１発でも落とせば、どれほど多くの米兵が横たわった姿でこの地域から運び出されることになるか、目の当たりにするだろう」と述べた。

item.title: イラン、ホルムズ海峡再開提案の受け入れを米に要求
item.description: [ドバイ １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ １８日 ロイター] - イランのアラグチ外相は１８日、ホルムズ海峡を７日以内に再開するために米国に提示した提案は依然として有効だと、イランのメディアに述べた。

イランは暫定停戦が崩壊した後の９月中旬に提案を提示。その後、米国から回答を受け取ったことを認めたが、イラン最高安全保障委員会のレザイ事務局長は先週、イランが提示した７項目の条件に対する米国の回答は「不十分」だったとし、交渉が停滞していることを明らかにした。

アラグチ氏はイスラム協力機構（ＯＩＣ）の会合に出席するため訪問したイラクの首都バグダッドで「われわれの立場は明確で、米国に提示した７日間の提案に基づいている。米国から意見が寄せられ、検討しているが、われわれの提案は依然として有効だ。米国側に誠意があれば、ホルムズ海峡再開への道筋は明らかだ」と語った。

イランの条件には、米国によるイランの港湾封鎖の解除、イランの石油輸出に対する米制裁の解除、域内の全ての戦線での戦闘終結などが含まれる。

アラグチ氏は、米国がイランの条件を受け入れれば、６日以内に海峡を再開し、その翌日に協議を再開できると述べた。

主要な対立点の一つは、米国が当初からイランの核開発問題を協議するよう求めていることだ。

バンス米副大統領は今月初め、米国の要求を満たして両国の戦争を終結させるには、イランがウラン濃縮能力を「意味のある」規模で削減する必要があると述べた。

イランは、交渉ではまずホルムズ海峡の再開と航行の安全回復に焦点を当てるべきだとしている。

item.title: UK housing market showing signs of mortgage rates impact, Rightmove says
item.description: Asking prices for British homes rose in October but there were signs that rising mortgage rates caused by the war in Iran were starting to weigh on affordability and more resilient parts of the market, property website Rightmove said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Asking prices for British homes rose in October but there were signs that rising mortgage rates caused by the war in Iran were starting to weigh on affordability and more resilient parts of the market, property website Rightmove said on Monday. Prices for property put on sale during Rightmove's October period — which runs from September 13 to October 10 — were 1% higher than a month earlier, when they rose by 0.7%. The survey is not seasonally adjusted and asking prices typically rise each October. This year, the rise was smaller than the 1.3% average for the month. "It's an early sign that higher mortgage costs are putting pressure on affordability even in markets with lower property prices, affecting the areas and types of property that buyers can afford," Colleen Babcock, property expert at Rightmove, said. The survey also showed: Asking prices were 0.1% lower than a year earlier, after a 0.8% annual drop in September The average two-year fixed mortgage interest rate rose to 5.55% from 5.29% in October, up sharply from 4.25% in February before the start of the Iran war Buyers were uncertain ahead of finance minister John Healey's budget later this month, while some first-time buyers were waiting for more detail on the First Home Scheme New sellers in more affordable and previously resilient parts of the UK were setting lower asking prices to offset affordability challenges Sales agreed were 8% below their level a year earlier The number of homes available for sale remained at its highest level for this time of year since 2014

item.title: ＩＭＦＣ会合で議長が世界経済のリスク警告、ロシア財務相発言中に多数退席
item.description:
Andrea Shalal David Lawder Jan Strupczewski
[バンコク １７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrea Shalal　David Lawder　Jan Strupczewski

[バンコク １７日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）の運営委員会、国際通貨金融委員会（ＩＭＦＣ）の議長を務めるサウジアラビアのジャドアーン財務相は１７日、世界経済は高い回復力を示しているものの「油断する余地はない」と警告した。一方ロシアのウクライナ侵攻を巡る対立により、ＩＭＦＣ会合ではロシアのシルアノフ財務相の発言中に多くの国の代表団が退席する場面があった。

ジャドアーン氏は、バンコクで開かれたＩＭＦ・世界銀行年次総会の閉幕記者会見で、戦争やエネルギー・食料安全保障への脅威、高水準の公的債務、人工知能（ＡＩ）の急速な発展に伴うリスクなど、深刻な課題が続いていると指摘した。その上で「ＩＭＦＣメンバーのメッセージは明確だ。油断する余地はない」と述べた。

各国の財政当局に対しては、社会的に脆弱な層の保護や成長促進投資を維持しながら財政余力の再構築を進めるよう求めた。中央銀行の独立性維持や民間主導の成長・投資を支える政策の重要性も強調した。

さらに戦争やエネルギー価格高騰の波及により短期的な資金繰り難に直面する国々への支援拡大を呼びかけ「過度な世界的不均衡や貿易摩擦への対応には国際協力が不可欠だ」と訴えた。

ＩＭＦのゲオルギエワ専務理事は会合が実りあるものだったと評価する一方、加盟国の間で経済格差拡大への不安が強まっているとの認識を表明。ＡＩ関連の価値連鎖に参加していない低所得国では、取り残されることへの懸念が広がっていると指摘した。

これらの発言に先立ち、ＩＭＦＣ会合ではロシアのシルアノフ財務相がロシア語で演説した際、多数の代表団が退席した。ドイツ連邦銀行のナーゲル総裁は関連行事で、出席者の約半数が退席したと明らかにするとともに「ロシアへの明確なメッセージだ。ウクライナに対する根拠のない侵略戦争が終結することが世界経済にとって最善だ」と語った。

ウクライナ国立銀行（中央銀行）のピシュニー総裁はロイターに、多数の財務当局者が退席したことに驚いたとした上で「深く感情を揺さぶられる瞬間だった」と述べた。

関係者によると、退席した代表団には英国、ドイツ、フランス、デンマーク、スウェーデン、フィンランド、ノルウェー、リトアニア、ラトビア、エストニアなどが含まれた。欧州の外交筋は「ウクライナ戦争は欧州にとって存亡に関わる問題だ。ロシアとの関係正常化はできない」と言い切った。

これに対して米財務省のブラウン次官補は、議長国を務める米国がロシアの２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）参加を支持していると説明。「危機を解決するには対話が必要であり、対話なくして紛争解決はできない」と述べた。

item.title: China's Q3 GDP growth set to pick up as exports power ahead
item.description: China's economy likely sped up slightly in the third quarter from a more than three-year low, helped by hot demand for the country's technological goods and fresh policy support, but further stimulus may be needed to sustain the momentum.
item.dc:creator: Kevin Yao
item.content:encoded: China's economy likely sped up slightly in the third quarter from a more than three-year low, helped by hot demand for the country's technological goods and fresh policy support, but further stimulus may be needed to sustain the momentum. Beijing has leaned heavily on exports for growth this year, but that engine faces growing pressure as investment in AI-related sectors cools and trade tensions with the European Union escalate. China's strategy of redirecting credit and resources from property towards high-tech industries has created a two-speed economy, where strong factory output and exports mask weak consumption and private investment. Data due on Monday is expected to show gross domestic product (GDP) grew 4.4% year-on-year in July-September, quickening from 4.3% in the second quarter - the weakest pace in more than three years, according to a Reuters poll. The projected growth is below the 4.6% forecast in a Reuters poll in July and would be below the lower end of the official full-year target of 4.5% to 5%. "While growth remains near the lower end of the government's target range, recent data suggest economic momentum improved meaningfully toward the end of the quarter, supported by resilient exports, a recovery in manufacturing activity and the initial effects of policy easing," said Zhou Hao, chief economist at Guotai Junan International. The official manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) showed factory activity [USN:L4N45L06S TEXT:"rose"] in September, ending two straight months of contraction, while a private manufacturing PMI showed growth in activity hit a five-month high. On a quarterly basis, the economy is forecast to have expanded 1.1% in the third quarter, accelerating from 0.9% in April-June, the poll showed. CHINA'S EXPORTS POWER AHEAD China's trade surplus widened more than expected in September as [USN:L6N4600GE TEXT:"exports surged"], keeping the country on track to surpass last year's record surplus of $1.2 trillion and likely intensifying trade tensions with major partners. A [USN:L6N45V0LF TEXT:"deal"] with the EU to rein in Chinese hybrid-vehicle shipments could weigh on the booming auto trade. GDP data is due on Monday at 0200 GMT. September activity data is expected to show industrial output growth accelerated to 5.5% year-on-year from 5.2% in August, while retail sales growth edged up to 0.6% from 0.4%. Fixed-asset investment in January-September is projected to have fallen 7.3%, versus a 7.2% drop in January-August. GDP growth is forecast to edge up to 4.5% in the fourth quarter, putting full-year growth at 4.5%, before easing to 4.4% in 2027, according to the poll. In late September, Beijing [USN:L1N45L0BK TEXT:"rolled out"] a fresh round of support measures, including targeted interest-rate cuts and mortgage subsidies, after the cabinet pledged stronger action to shore up growth and meet its annual target. Earlier this month, authorities also allocated 550 billion yuan ($82 billion) in unused government [USN:L6N45V0EV TEXT:"debt quotas"] to help ease local government financial strains and support infrastructure spending. "There remains room for further support measures, such as policies to boost employment and incomes and other measures to boost domestic demand," Lynn Song, ING's chief Greater China economist, said in a note. "Should economic momentum remain subdued into year-end, policymakers may respond with further fiscal stimulus and a broader easing of monetary policy." China is likely to rely more on fiscal stimulus to spur growth, as faster [USN:L1N460014 TEXT:"producer price gains"] and a pickup in consumer inflation leave the central bank with limited room for high-profile monetary easing. Analysts polled by Reuters expect the central bank to keep its benchmark lending rates, the loan prime rates, and banks' reserve requirement ratio unchanged through the first quarter of 2027. An expected Politburo meeting and the annual Central Economic Work Conference in December could offer fresh clues on Beijing's policy priorities for next year.

item.title: AI isn’t Asia’s only game in town: Manishi Raychaudhuri
item.description: As doubts mount over Asia's AI boom, some of the region's strongest returns are building far from the hype. While tech dominates the headlines, old-economy mainstays are also key drivers of the broader market story.
item.dc:creator: Manishi Raychaudhuri
item.content:encoded: As doubts mount over [USN:L1N4230I4 TEXT:"Asia's AI boom"], some of the region's strongest returns are building far from the hype. While tech dominates the headlines, old-economy mainstays are also key drivers of the broader market story. Technology accounts for six of Asia's 15 best-performing market sectors in 2026 thus far. But the remaining nine tell a non-tech story anchored in financials, energy, industrials and process industries. Admittedly, some of these themes overlap with the AI capital expenditure juggernaut. For example, investments in power generation, grid infrastructure and industrial cooling are clearly being propelled by data centre needs. But AI is not the only driver of these old-economy investment sweet spots, as geopolitical unrest and high energy prices are also playing a role. Fears about a slowdown in the tech boom may rattle Asian markets — as we saw [USN:L1N45Z05C TEXT:"last week"] — but they will not necessarily bring the Asian surge to a screeching halt. DEFENCE AND INFRASTRUCTURE Rising global defence spending has been a major investment driver worldwide this year, as military tensions escalate, most notably in the Middle East and Europe. This trend has been building ever since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in 2022 and has skyrocketed as US President Donald Trump has put more pressure on European allies to increase defence spending. North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) members, which account for 65% of global defence expenditure, committed in June 2025 to raise their annual defence spending to 5% of gross domestic product by 2035. Global defence spending represented only 2.4% of global GDP in 2025. The widening conflict in the Middle East, which escalated following the US-Israeli strikes on Iran on February 28, has also highlighted the vulnerability of countries throughout the Gulf. Asian defence manufacturers stand to gain from this global defence spending boom as Western capacity constraints potentially give Asian rivals an edge in delivery times and prices for comparable equipment. According to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute, South Korea supplied 8.6% of all arms imported by European NATO members during 2021–25, ahead of Israel's 7.7% and France's 7.4%. This came as Europe's overall arms imports roughly tripled. At the same time, “insourcing” of defence manufacturing – creating a homegrown military-industrial complex – is already a trend in several Asian nations. India aims for 70% defence "indigenisation" by 2027, Indonesia seeks 60% local content in defence equipment by 2030, and Vietnam is targeting 50% domestic inputs in select armaments by 2030. Increasing defence needs and military modernization are also spurring a broader infrastructure buildout globally. This includes reinforced bridges, roads, ports and railways, which are needed to transport heavy equipment, alongside fortified energy grids, telecommunications services, and cyber networks. McKinsey forecasts $106 trillion in global infrastructure investment through 2040, with Asia accounting for roughly 65% of that. The region's domestic industry has several advantages, including local ties, inexpensive state financing and integrated operations that can lower costs and speed delivery. Asia’s own infrastructure buildout could be mammoth too. Regional transport infrastructure alone could require investment of $2.6 trillion annually through 2035, according to the Asian Transport Observatory and the Asian Development Bank. That would represent more than three times the roughly $800 billion annual average spent from 2020 to 2025. Reflecting these trends, the order books of major Asian industrial and defence groups — including Larsen & Toubro , Hanwha Aerospace (012450.KS) and China Railway Group — already stand at several times annual revenue, supporting a robust growth outlook. GREEN GLOBALIZATION The global drive for energy independence should also benefit Asia, the leader in clean energy technologies. The stickiness of crude oil prices above $100 a barrel – and the related shock of the closure of the Strait of Hormuz this year – should push more consumers, businesses and governments toward renewables, particularly solar power, battery energy storage, offshore wind and electric vehicles. While Chinese companies currently dominate this space, fierce domestic competition, termed "involution," has dampened their margins, just as trade friction with the US and Europe has led to higher tariffs. Companies best positioned may be those with significant overseas revenue and well-established foreign manufacturing facilities and supply chains that can overcome tariff walls and trade restrictions. According to FactSet, Chinese EV makers BYD and Geely (0175.HK) draw 43% and 23% of their respective revenue from abroad, while Chinese battery titan CATL (300750.SZ) generates 34% of its revenue overseas. CAVEAT EMPTOR This strategy is no slam dunk, of course. Swapping AI exposure for heavy industry and state-backed defence does not eliminate risk — it merely trades tech valuation hype for other more familiar hazards. Defence and infrastructure orders come mostly from governments, raising the risk of bureaucratic delays, cost overruns, and abrupt legislative budget cuts. On the green energy front, the risk remains that Asia’s fierce domestic price wars could spread outward when companies compete in foreign markets. Meanwhile, prolonged inflation, elevated energy prices and high interest rates could slow infrastructure buildouts and trigger corporate defaults. And a truly massive AI pullback could have ripple effects across the region’s markets. Yet, for now, Asia's old economy continues to offer genuine substance beyond all the tech-driven hype. (The views expressed here are those of Manishi Raychaudhuri , the founder and CEO of Emmer Capital Partners Ltd and the former head of Asia-Pacific Equity Research at BNP Paribas Securities.) Enjoying this column? Check out Reuters Open Interest (ROI), your essential new source for global financial commentary. Follow ROI on LinkedIn, and X. And listen to the Morning Bid daily podcast on Apple , Spotify , or the Reuters app . Subscribe to hear Reuters journalists discuss the biggest news in markets and finance seven days a week.

item.title: 米アンソロピック、ＡＩの安全性確保に向けた法案を議員に提案＝報道
item.description: [１６日 ロイター] - 米ニュースサイトのポリティコは１６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの代表者が、最先端...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米アンソロピック、ＡＩの安全性確保に向けた法案を議員に提案＝報道 7:59 配信

写真は米アンソロピックのイベントブース。9月17日、米カリフォルニア州サンフランシスコで撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria

[１６日 ロイター] - 米ニュースサイトのポリティコは１６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックの代表者が、最先端ＡＩモデルの安全性とセキュリティーを確保する法案の導入に向け、米議会議員らに草案を働きかけていると報じた。事情に詳しい３人の情報筋の話だとしている。

この法案には、ＡＩモデルが１０億ドルを超える損害をもたらすか、５０人以上の死亡または重傷を負わせることにつながる予見可能かつ差し迫ったリスクをもたらす場合に限り、政府が公開や使用を阻止できるようにすることを定めた。

詳細は下記の通り。

・ポリティコによると、提案された草案は生物兵器の製造や導入を防いだり、ＡＩモデルが制御やサイバー攻撃を回避したりすることを目的としている。

・アンソロピックの広報担当者はロイターに対し、アンソロピックが今年発表した「先進ＡＩフレームワーク」に盛り込んだ提案を草案に反映していると説明した。

・この広報担当者によると、草案は政府に対して「最も強力なＡＩモデルの危険な展開を阻止または抑止する能力」を与えるとともに、開発者に対して最先端ＡＩモデルの訓練の実施や、結果の透明性確保、および第三者による評価を得ることを義務付ける。

・商務省は、ロイターからのコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

・報道によると、商務省に登録された独立した評価機関が、最先端ＡＩモデルと開発機関を定期的に評価する役割を担うと草案に盛り込まれた。

・良い評価結果を得るための買収行為がない限り、開発機関がこれらの評価機関に報酬を支払うことができることも記載されている。

・評価機関が最先端ＡＩモデルに「差し迫った具体的なリスク」があると判断した場合、評価完了から７２時間以内に商務省に報告しなければならないと明記している。

・商務省は危険性があることを認定した場合、裁判官に対してＡＩモデルの停止を要請することができる。草案には、他のいかなる米政府、機関、または職員も開発、導入、または内部利用を停止することを禁じると定めた。

・首都ワシントンの連邦地裁の裁判官がＡＩモデルの停止を命じることができる権限を持つと草案に定めた。

item.title: 米マイクロソフト、英データセンター契約から撤退＝英紙
item.description: [１８日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトが英クラウドサービス企業エヌスケールとのデータセンター契約から撤退したと、英...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米マイクロソフト、英データセンター契約から撤退＝英紙 7:48 配信

マイクロソフトのロゴ。2025年3月、パリ近郊イッシーレムリノーの同社オフィスで撮影。REUTERS/Gonzalo Fuentes

[１８日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトが英クラウドサービス企業エヌスケールとのデータセンター契約から撤退したと、英紙テレグラフが１８日に報じた。

同紙によると、マイクロソフトはエヌスケールの２大顧客の１社で、英エセックス州ラウトンのデータセンターに関する契約を最近解除した。

同紙は撤退の理由に言及していない。マイクロソフトはロイターに対し、コメントを控えた。

テレグラフによると、エヌスケールは同プロジェクトで度重なる遅延に直面していた。英送電網担当者は同社に対し、データセンターへの電力供給が２０３０年代まで見込めないと伝えていたという。

エヌスケールの広報担当者はロイターに対し、「マイクロソフトとの関係は引き続き強固で長期的なものだ。今回のロンドン全域の送電網問題は残念だが、他の契約には影響しない」と述べた。

「ラウトンの事業と英国への取り組みを引き続き堅持している。英国での他の拡張候補地に加え、同施設向けの代替電源も検討している」と説明した。

エヌスケールは９月、米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を申請した。目論見書によると、マイクロソフトとアンソロピックが主要顧客となる見通し。

エヌスケールは、計算資源や電力、データセンターなどのインフラに加え、人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルの学習や稼働に使うソフトウエアを提供している。

エヌビディアが出資する同社は、コアウィーブ、ネビウス、クルーソー、ラムダと競合する。設立以降急成長しており、わずか２年半で契約総額は１億ドルから１０３０億ドル超に拡大した。

item.title: NFL roundup: Browns edge Ravens to grab share of AFC North lead
item.description: Andre Szmyt kicked a 37-yard field goal as time expired to give the Cleveland Browns a 13-10 victory over the visiting Baltimore Ravens on Sunday and a share of first place in the AFC North.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Andre Szmyt kicked a 37-yard field goal as time expired to give the Cleveland Browns a 13-10 victory over the visiting Baltimore Ravens on Sunday and a share of first place in the AFC North. Deshaun Watson connected with Jerry Jeudy on a 33-yard pass to the Baltimore 29-yard line with 22 seconds remaining to set up the decisive kick. Szmyt's initial attempt from 42 yards was blocked by Keyon Martin, who was flagged for offside. Szmyt then drilled his second attempt through the uprights. Carson Schwesinger racked up 13 tackles and forced a fumble for the Browns (4-2), who are tied with the Ravens (4-2) and Pittsburgh Steelers (4-2) atop the division. Watson was 16-for-26 for 164 yards as Cleveland halted a three-game slide against Baltimore. Tyler "Snoop" Huntley completed 19 of 31 passes for 165 yards and one touchdown for the Ravens as he started in place of Lamar Jackson (ankle) for the second straight week. Steelers 26, Buccaneers 19 (OT) Aaron Rodgers threw touchdown passes in the fourth quarter and overtime and Chris Boswell made four field goals to lead Pittsburgh to a comeback win in overtime over host Tampa Bay. The Steelers erased a 16-3 fourth quarter deficit with 16 straight points in the period. The Bucs tied the game at 19 with three seconds left on a 53-yard field goal by Chase McLaughlin. In overtime, Rodgers led a 12-play, 70-yard drive, capped by a 6-yard touchdown pass to Germie Bernard with 3:15 left in overtime. Bernard caught 11 passes for 87 yards and DK Metcalf caught 11 passes for 93 yards. Jalon Daniels, who made his third consecutive start for injured Baker Mayfield (thumb), was sacked on fourth down by Jalen Ramsey on a corner blitz to end the game. Pittsburgh's defense sacked Daniels five times and intercepted him twice. Daniels completed 22 of 43 for 164 and a touchdown. Bears 31, Falcons 23 Caleb Williams returned from a three-game absence to complete 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards and a touchdown to help visiting Chicago stave off Atlanta. Williams showed little rust after suffering a hamstring tear on Sept. 20, connecting with eight different receivers for the Bears, who won their third game in four tries. D'Andre Swift rushed for two touchdowns for Chicago, which saw its 24-point fourth-quarter lead dwindle to eight before holding on. Michael Penix Jr. completed 19 of 33 passes for 225 yards and three touchdowns for Atlanta, which dropped its second straight. He threw two touchdown passes to Kyle Pitts Sr. and a pair of two-point conversion passes to slice the Bears' lead to eight with 5:41 to play. Texans 34, Jaguars 31 CJ Stroud threw for 312 yards and three touchdowns to set the stage for Ka'imi Fairbairn's game-winning 49-yard field goal as time expired, helping Houston pull out a narrow win over Jacksonville in London. Stroud completed 24 of 34 passes with one interception. Tight end Foster Moreau caught two passes, both touchdowns, while Jaylin Noel had a career-high 107 receiving yards and a touchdown for the Texans. Trevor Lawrence completed 24 of 41 passes for 306 yards, four touchdowns and one pick for the Jaguars, who had their three-game winning streak snapped. Bhayshul Tuten had 39 rushing yards and four catches for 48 yards and two TD catches. Travis Hunter Jr. became the first NFL player since Brian Dawkins in 2002 with a TD catch and interception in the same game. Titans 26, Colts 20 Joey Slye connected on a tie-breaking 49-yard field goal with 2:03 left as visiting Tennessee upset Indianapolis for its first win of the season. Slye added a 44-yarder with 43 seconds remaining for his fourth field goal after Tennessee got a fourth-down stop. The comeback from a 13-point halftime deficit gave head coach Robert Saleh his first win with the club. Amani Hooker finished with a career-high 13 tackles and an interception while Tennessee notched six sacks. Daniel Jones hit 22 of 42 passes for 269 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions for Indianapolis while Jonathan Taylor ran for 94 yards on 21 carries. That included a game-tying 4-yard touchdown with 5:32 to play. Patriots 26, Jets 19 Drake Maye tossed three touchdown passes and New England extended its winning streak to three games with a home victory over New York. Maye completed 18 of 32 passes for 235 yards. Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas and Hunter Henry had New England's touchdown receptions, while Douglas caught seven passes for 86 yards. New York's Geno Smith completed 20 of 30 passes for 252 yards and a touchdown but was intercepted for the first time this season. The Jets received four field goals from Jason Sanders and a game-high 11 tackles (six solo) from Jamien Sherwood. Panthers 25, Eagles 14 Bryce Young threw two touchdown passes to Tommy Tremble and Carolina's defense was solid in a road victory over short-handed Philadelphia. Young finished 20-for-39 for 281 yards. Backfield mate Chuba Hubbard rushed for 120 yards and a touchdown on 28 carries and Ryan Fitzgerald kicked two long field goals to help the Panthers to their second road triumph in three tries this season. Tanner McKee threw for 215 yards and a touchdown in his season debut for the Eagles, who lost their fourth consecutive game. McKee filled in for Jalen Hurts (blood clot), who was placed on injured reserve Saturday. The Eagles punted eight times and collected 17 first downs. Saints 34, Giants 27 Tyler Shough threw three touchdown passes and ran for a TD and visiting New Orleans held off the New York Giants. The Saints ended a three-game losing streak as they rushed for a season-high 175 yards and Martin Emerson Jr. had two of the team's three interceptions. Shough completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards and connected with Bryce Lance, Alvin Kamara and Chris Olave for scores after the Giants took a 10-0 lead. Jameis Winston passed for one touchdown and two interceptions for the Giants before being replaced by J.J. McCarthy, who led a dramatic late comeback. McCarthy, who completed 11 of 21 passes for 243 yards, piloted three scoring drives and a fourth drive which stalled at the Saints 14-yard line in the waning seconds. Malik Nabers finished with 12 catches for 165 yards for New York. --Field Level Media

item.title: スバル、20年代後半にＳＤⅤ投入、開発期間も4割短縮
item.description: [佐野市（栃木県） １９日 ロイター] - ＳＵＢＡＲＵ（スバル）は、２０２０年代後半にソフトウエア定義車両（ＳＤＶ）を...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
スバル、20年代後半にＳＤⅤ投入、開発期間も4割短縮 7:42 配信

写真はＳＵＢＡＲＵ（スバル）のロゴ。4月1日、米ニューヨーク市で撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[佐野市（栃木県） １９日 ロイター] - ＳＵＢＡＲＵ（スバル）は、２０２０年代後半にソフトウエア定義車両（ＳＤＶ）を投入する。ＳＤＶの中核となる新開発の制御統合ＥＣＵ（電子制御ユニット）を全車種に順次搭載する。ハードウエア、ソフトウエア、実車検証を一体で進める開発手法に切り替え、車両開発に要する期間を現状より約４割短縮する。１８日の開発戦略説明会で方針を示した。

同社は今後、制御統合ＥＣＵを通じて独自の運転支援機能「アイサイト」と「走る・曲がる・止まる」に直結する車両制御を高度化し、購入後も無線通信によるソフトウエアの更新（ＯＴＡ）を通じて車を進化させる。 制御統合ＥＣＵの核となる半導体は米アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイシス（ＡＭＤ）と共同開発した。ＡＩ（人工知能）の活用や高性能半導体の採用はコスト上昇要因となるが、半導体を含む技術の内製化を進め、 電気自動車（ＥＶ）、ハイブリッド車、ガソリン車で電子プラットフォームを全車共通化するなどして価格を抑える。

柴田英司常務執行役員は、ＯＴＡによって運転支援、自動運転、走行性能などの機能を高め、「使えば使うほど、どんどん車自体が良くなっていくことを狙う」と述べた。

ＳＤＶを巡っては、スバルに約２１％出資するトヨタ自動車が独自のソフトウェアプラットフォーム（基盤）「アリーン」を新車に搭載し、３０年までに世界で販売する全車種をＳＤＶにする計画を掲げており、３５年には提携先などの車にもアリーンを展開したい考えを示している。スバルは現時点でアリーンを採用する計画はない。

車両開発期間の４割短縮に向けては、車両の試作工程をデジタルシミュレーションに置き換える。設計、開発車両の実車検証、量産準備といった各工程を順番に進めるのではなく、同時並行的に進める。デジタルシミュレーションやＡＩを活用しつつ、実車で走行性能や安全性の検証時間も確保する。ＥＶやＳＤＶへの対応が急がれる中、限られた資源で商品投入のスピードと競争力を高める。

中国勢は約２年と従来より大幅に短い周期でＥＶの新型車を投入し、価格競争力や運転支援技術、コネクテッド機能を進化させている。スバルは、部品や車台の共通化、デジタル技術の活用を進め、品質を維持しながら開発の迅速化とコスト低減を図る。車種間の部品共用率を５０％まで高めて部品点数を削減し、開発の生産性を現状から倍増させる。

乾保常務執行役員は、スバルとしては単純に開発期間の短さを競うのではなく、「仮に開発期間が若干長くても、しっかり市場の要望に応えていく柔軟性を持ちたい」と説明。「最終的な商品のこだわりにかける時間をアジャイル（柔軟）に、いかにその短期（の開発期間）の中に入れ込められるか」が勝負になるとの考えを示した。

開発現場では、部門や取引先との間で設計を順番に引き渡す従来の方法を改め、同じ場所・情報・目標を共有するチームで開発を進める体制に移行し、車種ごとに個別最適化してきた開発の在り方を見直す。車種間の部品共用率を５０％にして部品点数を減らし、デジタルを活用するなどして生産性を現状から倍増させる。

item.title: Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv makes emergency landing after bomb threat, Sky News reports
item.description: An Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv to Vienna has made an emergency landing in the Bulgarian capital after a bomb threat, Sky news reported on Sunday, citing Bulgaria's Ministry of Transport and Communications.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv to Vienna has made an emergency landing in the Bulgarian capital after a bomb threat, Sky news reported on Sunday, citing Bulgaria's Ministry of Transport and Communications. Reuters could not immediately verify the report.

item.title: Brookfield's $2.53 billion bid for Reliance Worldwide clears 'go shop' hurdle
item.description: Reliance Worldwide said on Monday that no rival bidder emerged during the "go shop" process under Brookfield's proposed acquisition of the Australian firm, prompting the board to reaffirm its unanimous recommendation for shareholders to back the deal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Reliance Worldwide (RWC.AX) said on Monday that no rival bidder emerged during the "go shop" process under Brookfield's (BN.TO) proposed acquisition of the Australian firm, prompting the board to reaffirm its unanimous recommendation for shareholders to back the deal. Here are some more details: The plumbing supplies firm [USN:L4N4571P4 TEXT:"agreed in September"] to a scheme implementation deed under which Brookfield Capital Partners and its affiliates would acquire all of Reliance Worldwide's shares for US$3.38 apiece in cash, valuing the firm at $2.53 billion. The offer implied a value of about A$4.87 per share based on the prevailing exchange rate on October 16. Investors can choose to be paid in US dollars or Australian dollars if the deal proceeds and is approved by shareholders, Reliance said last month. The companies had agreed to a "go shop" provision, unusual in Australian deals, that allowed Reliance Worldwide to seek rival bids, share due diligence materials and negotiate terms. "Whilst there was extensive engagement with potential buyers during the 'Go Shop' process, no proposal was received," Reliance said in its statement. After that period, customary no-shop, no-talk and no-due-diligence restrictions under the scheme implementation deed have come into effect. The board again recommended that shareholders vote in favour of the scheme, in the absence of a superior proposal.

item.title: 対ロ制裁見送り、最終決定でないとトランプ氏 国務長官「60日かけ影響評価」
item.description:
Nandita Bose Gram Slattery
[１７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nandita Bose　Gram Slattery

[１７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１７日、ロシア関連の制裁や関税の実施をいったん見送ったものの、最終決定はまだ下していないと述べた。一方ルビオ国務長官は、実施見送りによる影響を評価するため、最大６０日間の検討期間を設ける考えを明らかにした。

トランプ氏は南部フロリダ州パームビーチの私邸で記者団に「私の決断がどうなるか、まだ皆さんは知らない。いずれ分かるだろう」と語った。

またトランプ氏は１８に自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で、今回の判断について「ロシアを愚かにも交渉の場から遠ざけるような事態を避けるためだ」と説明した。

トランプ氏は前月、ウクライナ侵攻を巡ってロシアへの圧力強化を求める議員らの要請を受けて「グラム法」と呼ばれる法律に署名したものの、１７日になって同法に基づく主要な対ロ制裁や関税を当面停止する大統領令に署名した。

停止対象にはロシア製品への関税や、ロシア産石油・天然ガスを購入する国への制裁措置が含まれており、来週発効する予定だった。大統領令には停止期間が明記されていないが、ルビオ氏によると、トランプ氏は６０日間の見直し期間を設けることを決定した。

ルビオ氏はウズベキスタン訪問に向かう前、記者団に「大統領は制裁と関税の発動が世界経済や米経済にどのような影響を与えるのかを分析するため、６０日間を確保したいと考えている」と述べた。

今回の制裁・関税見送りについてウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアのプーチン大統領を勢い付かせ、戦争の長期化につながると批判した。

ルビオ氏は１７日、ロシア産ディーゼル燃料の世界市場向け供給拡大に関する米国とロシアの合意についても正当化し、この措置はイランとの戦争やエネルギー供給混乱を背景に上昇している燃料価格の抑制を狙ったものだと説明した。

ルビオ氏は「そのディーゼル燃料はいずれにせよ販売される。違いは、米国がどれだけ受け取るかだけだ」と述べた。

ライト米エネルギー長官は１８日のＡＢＣテレビの番組で、この合意は「戦争終結を促すためのアメであり、ロシアへの経済的な救済策ではない」と強調。さらにＣＮＮの番組では「ロシアが追加のディーゼル燃料を輸出するには、ウクライナとの紛争を沈静化させる必要がある。ロシア産燃料の追加供給は米国の消費者に利益をもたらし、ロシア・ウクライナ戦争の和平に向けた一歩にもなり得る」と語った。

item.title: Oil slips as Trump's sanction waiver may lead to more Russian fuel supplies
item.description: Oil prices slipped on Monday after US President Donald Trump waived sanctions and tariffs on Russia that may lead to more Russian fuel exports.
item.dc:creator: Florence Tan
item.content:encoded: Oil prices slipped on Monday after US President Donald Trump waived sanctions and tariffs on Russia that may lead to more Russian fuel exports. Brent crude futures fell $1.43, or 1.30%, to $108.43 a barrel by 2340 GMT after settling at its highest since May 19 on Friday. US West Texas Intermediate crude was at $100.88 a barrel, down 53 cents, or 0.52%. Trump signed an [USN:L6N464042 TEXT:"executive order"] on Friday waiving key sanctions and tariffs under the law known as the Graham Act, which he signed last month at the urging of lawmakers who want to pressure Moscow over its war in Ukraine. However, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the president will use up to 60 days to assess the economic impact of the waiver. The move comes after Trump struck a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to export diesel to the United States. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said these US actions will [USN:L6N46405N TEXT:"hurt Ukraine."] Brent crude oil briefly touched $110 a barrel on Friday for the first time since May as tensions and security threats in the Middle East raised concerns over the safety of shipping and tighter global energy supplies. Intensified attacks on commercial vessels cut Gulf crude flows sharply to about 8.5 million barrels per day on a seven-day average last week from more than 20 million bpd the week before, analytics firm Kpler said in a Friday note. At least 10 confirmed incidents involving commercial vessels were reported last week, it added. Potentially raising the stakes in the Middle East war, [USN:L1N46401H TEXT:"Egypt"] said it is ready to provide Saudi Arabia with the support it needs to defend its security and stability against Yemen's Iran-allied Houthis.

item.title: 米、ウクライナへの情報提供を再開 一時停止後＝ゼレンスキー氏
item.description: [１８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１８日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、米国がロシアのミサイル攻撃に対する防衛を支える重要情報の提供を一時停止後に再開したと明らかにした。１８日に発言内容が公表された。

ウクライナは、国内各地に向けてロシアが波状的に発射する高速の弾道ミサイルを探知するため、米国の情報に依存してきた。トランプ米大統領は情報共有を続けていると述べていたが、ウクライナ当局者は、事前の警告なしにロシアの攻撃を受けたケースがあったとしていた。

ゼレンスキー氏は米ＮＢＣの番組「ミート・ザ・プレス」で、情報共有は中断されたものの、その後「停止が解除された」と説明。「このことには大変感謝している。今は機能している」と述べた。

一方、ロシア産ディーゼル燃料（軽油）の輸入契約締結や、対ロシア制裁の適用免除措置など、米国の他の行動はウクライナに打撃を与えると指摘した。

「米国が正式にロシア側につき、この２カ国が手を組めば、当然われわれは勝利できず、持ちこたえることもできなくなる」と語った。

「われわれは彼（トランプ氏）を信頼したいし、決定を変えてくれることを望んでいる。これらは全て間違いであり、われわれの助けにはならないと思うからだ。米国のためにもならない」と語った。

トランプ氏は１８日午後、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、自身の意思決定は「愚かにもロシアを交渉のテーブルから遠ざける」ような事態を避けることを目指したものだと記した。

ベセント米財務長官はＮＢＣに対し、ウクライナはロシアが受けていない米国の支援を得ていると指摘。情報共有や、ウクライナへの再販売に向けた他国への米国製弾薬の供給を挙げた。

ただ、ゼレンスキー氏のインタビュー放送後に「ミート・ザ・プレス」に出演したベセント氏は、米国がウクライナを同盟国と見なしているかと繰り返し問われても、直接回答しなかった。

item.title: エジプト、サウジ防衛巡り軍事支援を示唆 中東情勢さらに緊迫も
item.description: [カイロ １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カイロ １８日 ロイター] - エジプト大統領府は１８日の声明で、サウジアラビアの安全と安定を守るため、同国が要請すれば必要な支援を提供する用意があると表明した。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が対サウジ攻撃を強化している中で、中東での紛争が一段と拡大する恐れが出てきた。

「エジプトはサウジアラビアの安全と安定、防衛資源、領土保全、そしてイスラム教の聖地を守るため、必要かつ可能なあらゆる支援を提供する」とした声明は、シシ大統領が主宰した国家防衛評議会の会合後に発表され、同会合には国会議長や首相、軍トップらも出席した。

シシ氏は１８日の演説で、イエメンで戦闘が再燃した後の９月１５日にエジプトを訪問したサウジのムハンマド皇太子およびサルマン国王の方針に沿って行動すると述べた。イエメンでは、国際的に承認された政府を支援するサウジ主導の有志連合と、首都サヌアおよび北部の大半を支配するフーシ派との戦闘がここ数週間で激化している。

またシシ氏は、サウジ支援のため軍の派遣を認める権限を得るために議会の緊急会合を招集した。アラブ世界有数の規模を誇るエジプト軍が介入する場合、フーシ派による攻撃対象となる可能性がある。フーシ派は数万人規模の戦闘員を擁し、ミサイルや無人機によって地域の安全保障を脅かしている。

議会は１８日に採決を行う見通しだったが、議論は１９日まで続く予定。複数の議員と地元メディアが明らかにした。

エジプト議会による追加協議の発表後、アブデルアティ外相はＸへの投稿で、サウジのファイサル外相と電話会談し、地域情勢や緊張緩和の重要性について協議したと明らかにした。

エジプトとサウジは緊密な戦略・経済関係を維持している。サウジやアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）など湾岸産油国は、２０１３年のモルシ元大統領の失脚後、エジプトに対し数十億ドル規模の支援や預金、投資を実施した。シシ氏はその翌年に大統領へ就任した。

エジプトは１５年に発足したサウジ主導の対フーシ派有志連合にも参加したが、内戦での戦闘参加は限定的だった。

サウジはフーシ派への対抗でトランプ米大統領に支援を求めた後、地域の同盟国やパキスタンとの連携を強化している。関係筋によると、トランプ大統領は米軍による直接攻撃には同意せず、米国は標的情報や情報共有の支援を提供している。

item.title: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (concussion) exits vs. Chiefs
item.description: Los Angeles Chargers wide receiver Ladd McConkey was ruled out with a concussion in the first half of Sunday's road game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles Chargers wide receiver Ladd McConkey was ruled out with a concussion in the first half of Sunday's road game against the Kansas City Chiefs. McConkey underwent further evaluation after being hit near midfield midway through the first quarter following a 17-yard completion from Justin Herbert. McConkey, 24, has 13 catches for 200 yards and one touchdown in five games this season. He was on the injury report with a foot injury during the week after sitting out against the Denver Broncos last week. Los Angeles was trailing 9-3 when McConkey was ruled out late in the second quarter. The Chargers trailed 19-3 at halftime. --Field Level Media

item.title: 債券売りでインフレ鈍化へ＝ラガルドＥＣＢ総裁
item.description:
Francesco Canepa
[バンコク １７日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は１７日、債...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
債券売りでインフレ鈍化へ＝ラガルドＥＣＢ総裁 7:09 配信

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁。10月14日、バンコクで撮影。REUTERS/Athit Perawongmeth

Francesco Canepa

[バンコク １７日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は１７日、債券売りによってユーロ圏の借り入れコストが上昇し、経済成長が抑制され、最終的にインフレも鈍化するとの見方を示した。

ここ数週間、債務やインフレへの懸念に加え、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資に伴う資金調達競争の激化を背景に、世界的に債券利回りが急上昇している。多額の債務を抱えるフランスは、特に大きな打撃を受けている。

ラガルド氏は、こうした状況により、消費者がイラン戦争に伴う燃料価格の上昇を吸収することは、ＥＣＢが９月に予測した以上に難しくなるとの見方を示した。

タイの首都バンコクに集まった各国の中央銀行総裁や財務相を前に、ラガルド氏は「経済成長は底堅さを保っているが、前回の会合以降、長期金利が著しく上昇するなど資金調達環境は引き締まっている」と指摘。「これにより成長が鈍化し、価格転嫁は９月の予測以上に抑制されるだろう」と語った。

ＥＣＢは過去４カ月間で２回利上げを実施し、１２月にも追加利上げが見込まれている。実施すれば政策金利は２．７５％となり、ＥＣＢが景気抑制的と見なす水準に達する。

ＥＣＢ理事会メンバーのナーゲル独連銀総裁も、今後の追加引き締めを示唆した。ただ、政策は入手するデータに基づき、会合ごとに判断するとした。

バンコクで開かれたＤＺ銀行のイベントで「われわれはインフレと闘っている。仕事はまだ終わっていないと考えている」と述べ、「さらなる対応が必要になる可能性がある」と語った。

同じ場で発言したＥＣＢ理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は、エネルギー価格の上昇が他の物価や賃金に波及する「二次的影響」をＥＣＢは注視すると述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＥＣＢ「予防的」追加利上げへ、米イラン紛争長期化で アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 アングル：ＡＩの経済金融への影響、ＥＣＢフォーラムで希望と懸念が交錯 アングル：金融市場はＥＣＢのタカ派化見込む、イラン戦による油価高騰で コラム：求むＥＣＢ総裁、危機に強い革新者 最終更新: 10/19(月) 7:09 ロイター

item.title: 豪チャレンジャー、第一ライフグループが未保有株取得へ予備的提案
item.description: [１９日 ロイター] - オーストラリアの保険会社チャレンジャーは１９日、第一ライフグループの豪子会社から、未保有の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
豪チャレンジャー、第一ライフグループが未保有株取得へ予備的提案 7:04 配信

第一ライフグループのロゴ。4月6日、東京で撮影。 REUTERS/Issei Kato

[１９日 ロイター] - オーストラリアの保険会社チャレンジャーは１９日、第一ライフグループの豪子会社から、未保有のチャレンジャー株を取得する予備的提案を受けたと発表した。提案は同社の企業価値を７９億４０００万豪ドル（５５億３０００万ドル）と評価しているという。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、ＴＡＬダイイチライフ・オーストラリア（ＴＤＡ）はチャレンジャー株２０．３６％を保有している。

第一ライフ側は１株当たり１１．８０豪ドルでの取得を提示した。チャレンジャー株の前週末１６日終値に１９．８％のプレミアムを乗せた水準となる。

提案には資産査定（デューデリジェンス）が満足のいく形で完了することなど、複数の条件が付いている。

チャレンジャーは声明で「当社取締役会は暫定的な提案を検討している」とした。

第一ライフは報道を受け、ＴＤＡがチャレンジャーに対し法的拘束力のない提案を提出したことを確認している、としたうえで、「現時点で法的拘束力のある取引を進めることに関して決定した事実はない」とのコメントを公表した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 アングル：ネパール土石流でインド人多数が行方不明、ヒンドゥー教聖地巡礼者ら アングル：アジア太平洋で非居住者の起債が活発、巨大テックの動き波及 コラム：静かに進むガソリン離れ、中国製ＥＶの世界展開が後押しか コラム：トランプ政権表す「メキシコ料理の頭字語」、続々登場も最適はＴＡＭＡＬＥＳ 最終更新: 10/19(月) 8:25 ロイター

item.title: Australia’s Challenger gets takeover bid from unit of Japan’s Daiichi Life
item.dc:creator: Reuters

item.title: マクロン仏大統領、暴動受け冷静さ呼びかけ 2400人逮捕
item.description:
Sybille de La Hamaide Clotaire Achi Abdul Saboor
[パリ／リモージュ １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sybille de La Hamaide　Clotaire Achi　Abdul Saboor

[パリ／リモージュ １８日 ロイター] - フランスのマクロン大統領は１８日、物価高や公共サービスの質低下に抗議する前日のデモが国内各地で暴動に発展したことを受け、国民に冷静な対応を呼びかけた。暴動は同国で近年最悪規模となり、数千人が逮捕され、商店が略奪や破壊の被害を受けた。

マクロン氏はテレビ放映された国民向け演説で「こうした映像を見て、われわれは皆、彼らは何を考えていたのか、フランス人がどうしてフランスにこんなことをできるのかと自問した」と述べた。

「何をもってしても正当化も説明も弁解もできない。今夜、われわれは皆、怒りと恥ずかしさを感じている」と語った。

１７日の暴動は、マクロン氏に対する根深い怒りを浮き彫りにした。マクロン氏は２０２７年に退任する予定だが、１０年に及ぶ在任期間は社会不満の高まり、経済の低迷、債務の膨張に特徴付けられるようになっている。

マクロン氏は、平和的に抗議していた人々の不満には正当な理由があるとし、混乱を引き起こそうとする人々の行動と混同すべきではないと述べた。

一部の右派政治家が求めていた非常事態宣言は見送った。ただ、公共施設や地元商店を守るために必要な場合、知事がデモを禁止できるよう政府として措置を講じるとした。

ヌニェス内相によると、１７日にはパリのデモで参加者１人が心停止で死亡した。全国で２４００人が逮捕され、警官約１０００人が負傷した。

パリのレピュブリック広場では１８日午後、警察とデモ参加者が再び衝突し、警察が催涙ガスを使用した。デモ参加者は積み上げられた自転車に火を放った。ロイターの記者によると、現場には数百人のデモ参加者がいたとみられる。

item.title: Japan's Daiichi Life unit tables offer to take over Australia's Challenger
item.description: A unit of Japan's Daiichi Life has made an indicative proposal to buy more than 79% of shares in Australian investment manager Challenger it does not already own, Challenger said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A unit of Japan's Daiichi Life (8750.T) has made an indicative proposal to buy more than 79% of shares in Australian investment manager Challenger (CGF.AX) it does not already own, Challenger said on Monday. Shares of the Australian firm jumped over 15% to A$11.33 by 2305 GMT, hitting their highest level since October 23, 2018. Under the proposal, the Japanese insurer is offering A$11.80 apiece, valuing Challenger at A$7.94 billion ($5.53 billion). The offer represents a premium of 19.8% over the stock's closing price on Friday. The unit, TAL Daiichi Life Australia Pty, holds 20.36% of the Australian investment manager, according to LSEG. Daiichi Life, through its unit, had initially acquired a 15.1% minority stake in Challenger from MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings in April 2025 . The takeover proposal is subject to a number of conditions including satisfactory completion of due diligence, Challenger said on Monday. "The Board of Challenger is considering the indicative offer," the Australian firm added. In a separate statement, Daiichi Life confirmed that TAL Daiichi Life Australia has submitted a non-binding proposal to the board of directors of Challenger, adding that no decision has been made by the company on proceeding with the binding transaction. Separately, Challenger reported a 5% rise in its assets under management to $31.9 billion for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, citing strong sales momentum across both domestic and offshore annuities. ($1 = 1.4360 Australian dollars)

item.title: Lyon go top after comeback win over Nice
item.description: Olympique Lyonnais came from behind to beat Nice 2-1 at home on Sunday and move top of a tightly packed Ligue 1 table.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Olympique Lyonnais came from behind to beat Nice 2-1 at home on Sunday and move top of a tightly packed Ligue 1 table. Lyon are one of five teams on 14 points after seven games but lead on goal difference after Pavel Sulc and American midfielder Tanner Tessmann cancelled out Elye Wahi’s 18th-minute opener for Nice. Lyon, who played the last 20 minutes with 10 men after substitute Keito Nakamura was dismissed for a dangerous studs-up challenge, survived a late scare when Wahi had an effort ruled out for offside four minutes into stoppage time. Lyon, with a goal difference of plus eight, sit ahead of defending champions Paris St Germain, Paris FC and Lille, all on plus five, and Monaco on plus four. Monaco, the league's last unbeaten side heading into the weekend, suffered their first defeat of the campaign as Noah Cadiou's 61st-minute penalty earned Lorient a 1-0 home victory. Paris FC were 4-3 winners over Rennes at Stade Jean-Bouin on Sunday in a topsy-turvy tussle which featured four spot-kicks. Newly capped France international Esteban Lepaul converted a hat-trick of penalties for Rennes but still ended up on the losing side, although his team are only one point off the league leaders in sixth place. Lassine Sinayoko struck the decisive penalty for Paris FC in the seventh minute of stoppage time, his second goal of the game after Maxime Lopez scored the first two for the Parisians. Earlier on Sunday, Olympique de Marseille recorded a second successive league win and their first convincing result of the season with a 5-2 triumph at Angers. Lilian Raolisoa gave the hosts a 14th-minute lead before former Angers midfielder Himad Abdelli equalised in the 37th minute for Marseille and Nouhoum Kamissoko netted his first senior goal to complete the turnaround. Amine Gouiri made it 3-1 on the rebound after Anthony Lopes saved his penalty, before Amine El Ouazzani converted a spot-kick for Angers. Late goals from Amine Harit and Igor Paixao lifted Marseille to ninth place with nine points.

item.title: Mbappe double helps Real Madrid sweep aside Sevilla ahead of El Clasico
item.description: Kylian Mbappe scored twice as Real Madrid closed the gap on LaLiga leaders Barcelona to six points with a 4-1 win over Sevilla at the Santiago Bernabeu on Sunday, a week before the rivals meet.
item.dc:creator: Ruairidh Barlow
item.content:encoded: Kylian Mbappe scored twice as Real Madrid closed the gap on LaLiga leaders Barcelona to six points with a 4-1 win over Sevilla at the Santiago Bernabeu on Sunday, a week before the rivals meet. Real, who have won three straight games in all competitions following the international break, climbed to third on 21 points, one behind Atletico Madrid, while Sevilla are sixth on 14. Elsewhere, Osasuna withstood second-half pressure from Racing Santander to win 2-0 in Jagoba Arrasate's first game back as manager. Two flying saves from Ionut Radu denied Alaves a point in a 2-1 defeat to Celta Vigo, while Real Sociedad won 5-2 at Malaga. REAL TURN ON THE STYLE Despite the suspended Vinicius Jr's absence, Real produced the fluid attacking football that has been lacking of late with Arda Guler again orchestrating their best work. After a stale opening, the Turkey international sparked the match into life. Sevilla appealed for a red card following an incident involving Guler and Peque Fernandez, but Guler responded minutes later by collecting Yan Diomande's pass and arrowing a shot into the top corner. Mbappe scored an equally impressive second in the 37th minute, turning brilliantly to burst through on goal before calmly beating Odysseas Vlachodimos. Fede Valverde, restored to right back by coach Jose Mourinho, made a crucial block to deny Felix Correia just before the hour as Sevilla threatened to work their way back into the contest. Diomande then exploited the space created by Sevilla’s more adventurous approach, evading his marker before sending Mbappe in behind the defence. Andres Castrin brought down the French forward, who got to his feet to convert the resulting penalty and effectively settle the contest. Substitute Manu Bueno reduced Sevilla’s arrears with a composed finish 10 minutes from time after Mbappe cheaply surrendered possession deep inside his own half. Diomande restored Real's three-goal advantage two minutes later, capping a fine display with a thunderous strike. Eder Militao received a warm ovation when he came on in the 85th minute for his first appearance since undergoing hamstring surgery in April. Mourinho will take encouragement from one of the most complete performances of his second spell at Real as they prepare for next Sunday's pivotal meeting with Barcelona.

item.title: Aaron Rodgers delivers another comeback as Steelers beat Bucs in OT
item.description: Aaron Rodgers threw touchdown passes in the fourth quarter and overtime and Chris Boswell made four field goals to lead the Pittsburgh Steelers to a 26-19 comeback win in overtime over the host Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Aaron Rodgers threw touchdown passes in the fourth quarter and overtime and Chris Boswell made four field goals to lead the Pittsburgh Steelers to a 26-19 comeback win in overtime over the host Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday. The Steelers (4-2) erased a 16-3 fourth quarter deficit with 16 straight points in the period. The Bucs (1-5) tied the game at 19 with three seconds left on a 53-yard field goal by Chase McLaughlin. In overtime, Rodgers led a 12-play, 70-yard drive, capped by a 6-yard touchdown pass to Germie Bernard with 3:15 left in overtime. Bernard caught 11 passes for 87 yards and DK Metcalf caught 11 passes for 93 yards. Jalon Daniels, who made his third consecutive start for injured Baker Mayfield (thumb), scrambled 10 yards to Tampa Bay's own 37 for a first down on fourth-and-nine on the Bucs' ensuing drive. Five plays later, Daniels was sacked on fourth down by Jalen Ramsey on a corner blitz to end the game. According to Pro Football Reference, it was Rodgers' 27th career fourth-quarter comeback. Rodgers completed 33 of 49 passes for 253 yards, two touchdowns and one interception. Pittsburgh's defense sacked Daniels five times and intercepted him twice. Daniels completed 22 of 43 for 164 and a touchdown. Jamel Dean picked off Daniels and returned it 40 yards to the Bucs' 3 with 1:38 to go in the fourth. Tampa Bay kept Pittsburgh out of the end zone on three consecutive plays, but the Steelers took a 19-16 lead on Boswell's fourth field goal - a 20-yarder with 1:21 left. After coming up with only a Boswell 52-yard field goal on their first nine possessions, the Steelers finally found the end zone with 13:48 left in the fourth. Rodgers connected with Darnell Washington on a 5-yard touchdown to cut Pittsburgh's deficit to 16-10. Pittsburgh regained possession when rookie Daylen Everette intercepted Daniels at the Bucs' 45. But after Rodgers was sacked for the fourth time, Pittsburgh settled for another Boswell field goal, cutting the lead to 16-13 with 8:08 left. Tampa Bay led 13-0 until just before halftime thanks to two McLaughlin field goals and Daniels' lone touchdown pass from 2 yards out to Emeka Egbuka with 14:52 left in the second quarter. --Field Level Media

item.title: Danish duo fire high-flying Lazio to 3-0 win over Juventus
item.description: Lazio's Danish duo made the difference in Turin as Oliver Provstgaard and Gustav Isaksen scored in a 3-0 win over Juventus on Sunday that lifted their side level with Inter Milan at the top of Serie A.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lazio's Danish duo made the difference in Turin as Oliver Provstgaard and Gustav Isaksen scored in a 3-0 win over Juventus on Sunday that lifted their side level with Inter Milan at the top of Serie A. Provstgaard broke the deadlock in the 37th minute, using his height to glance home Mattia Zaccagni's cross after Lazio worked a short corner on the left. Fellow Dane Isaksen doubled the lead in the 66th minute, collecting a pass from Tavares on the right before shifting the ball onto his left foot and bending a low finish into the far corner. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru completed the scoring in the 89th minute, launching a counter-attack from inside his own half and driving into the box before slotting home a low finish as frustrated home supporters jeered Juventus through to the final whistle. Lazio have 19 points from seven matches, level with Inter, who maintained their unbeaten start to the domestic season with a 3-1 [USN:L6N46307R TEXT:"comeback "]victory over Bologna on Saturday. MILAN SURVIVE ATALANTA FIGHTBACK AC Milan survived a late Atalanta fightback to claim an entertaining 3-2 home victory earlier on Sunday. The hosts opened the scoring in the 24th minute through a Goncalo Ramos penalty, before Adrien Rabiot doubled their advantage shortly before the break. Mario Gila made it 3-0 in the 57th minute, seemingly putting the contest beyond Atalanta. However, Gianluca Gaetano reduced the deficit in the 66th minute and Nikola Krstovic added a second for Atalanta in the 81st to set up a tense finish. Two minutes later, Mike Maignan rushed out to deny Davide Zappacosta in a one-on-one, parrying the effort with his legs to preserve Milan's lead. Fiorentina's struggles continued as they suffered a 3-1 defeat at home to Como, leaving them second from bottom in the table with four points from seven matches. Quickfire goals from Mattia Liberali and Nico Paz around the half-hour mark put Como in command before Marin Pongracic pulled one back before the break, but Anastasios Douvikas sealed the victory for the visitors early in the second half. Como are fifth with 14 points.

item.title: Bryce Young, Panthers control banged-up Eagles
item.description: Bryce Young threw two touchdown passes to Tommy Tremble and the Carolina Panthers' defense was solid in a 25-14 road victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Bryce Young threw two touchdown passes to Tommy Tremble and the Carolina Panthers' defense was solid in a 25-14 road victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday afternoon. Young finished 20-for-39 for 281 yards. Backfield mate Chuba Hubbard rushed for 120 yards and a touchdown on 28 carries. Ryan Fitzgerald kicked two long field goals to help the Panthers (3-2) to their second road triumph in three tries this year. Tanner McKee threw for 215 yards and a touchdown in his season debut as the Eagles (2-4) lost their fourth consecutive game. McKee, appearing in his seventh career game, filled in for Jalen Hurts, who was placed on injured reserve Saturday after he was diagnosed with a blood clot in his leg last week. The Eagles punted eight times and collected 17 first downs. Fitzgerald's 52-yard field goal on the first possession of the second half marked the only scoring in the third quarter. The Panthers went on a 92-yard drive that concluded with Hubbard's 1-yard TD run early in the fourth quarter. A two-point conversion pass failed, leaving the score at 19-7. The Eagles responded with McKee's 19-yard touchdown throw to DeVonta Smith with 10:42 to play. A blocked Eagles punt gave Carolina favorable field position. The Panthers needed to go just 48 yards for an insurance touchdown, with Young connecting with Tremble on a 19-yard scoring strike with 6:34 left. Carolina went up 10-0 on Young's 12-yard pass to Tremble in the second quarter. Dameon Pierce put the Eagles on the board with a 2-yard run with 2:42 remaining in the first half. Carolina outgained the Eagles 178-110 in the half, which ended at 10-7. The Panthers, fresh off an open week on the schedule, got a 47-yard field goal from Fitzgerald on their first possession. Philadelphia's first two possessions resulted in a net of minus-3 yards. The Eagles punted three times in the first quarter. --Field Level Media

item.title: Saints build big lead, then need to hold off Giants for win
item.description: Tyler Shough threw three touchdown passes and ran for a touchdown and the visiting New Orleans Saints held off the New York Giants 34-27 on Sunday afternoon in East Rutherford, N.J.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tyler Shough threw three touchdown passes and ran for a touchdown and the visiting New Orleans Saints held off the New York Giants 34-27 on Sunday afternoon in East Rutherford, N.J. The Saints (2-4) ended a three-game losing streak as they rushed for a season-high 175 yards and Martin Emerson Jr. had two of the team's three interceptions. Jameis Winston passed for one touchdown and two interceptions for the Giants (3-2-1) before being replaced by J.J. McCarthy, who led a dramatic late comeback. On the first possession of the second half, Shough threw a short pass to Alvin Kamara, who turned the play into a 31-yard touchdown that gave New Orleans a 17-10 lead. Shough sneaked 1 yard for a touchdown and the Saints' fourth score in as many possessions, pushing the lead to 24-10. Daniel Carlson's 51-yard field goal increased the lead to 27-10 at the end of the third quarter. Julian Blackmon's interception of Winston led to Shough's 18-yard touchdown pass to Chris Olave to expand the lead to 34-10. McCarthy replaced Winston and threw an interception before driving the Giants 45 yards in 2:31 and capping the sequence with a 5-yard touchdown pass to Tyrone Tracy Jr. New York converted a subsequent 2-point conversion and then needed only 48 seconds to score again on McCarthy's 24-yard touchdown pass to Isaiah Likely (with a failed 2-point try). After forcing a Saints 3-and-out, Dominic Zvada's 41-yard field goal trimmed the New Orleans lead to 34-27 with 2:04 left. New York forced another punt and McCarthy, who finished with 243 passing yards, drove the Giants to the Saints 14, but they turned the ball over on downs with five seconds left. Malik Nabers finished with 12 catches for 165 yards for New York. The Giants' second possession was a 12-play, 93-yard drive that ended with Winston's 17-yard touchdown pass to Tracy to give them a 7-0 lead at the end of the first quarter. Zvada's 34-yard field goal early in the second quarter increased the lead to 10-0. Carlson kicked a 58-yard field goal for New Orleans' first points, and on the ensuing kickoff Charlie Jones fumbled and Oscar Delp recovered for the Saints at the New York 28. On fourth-and-goal, Shough threw a 2-yard touchdown pass to Bryce Lance to tie the score 10-10 at halftime. --Field Level Media

item.title: McLaren venderá cinco monoplazas de F1, todos ellos pilotados por campeones y uno por Brad Pitt
item.description: McLaren va a poner a la venta cinco monoplazas de Fórmula 1 en perfecto estado de funcionamiento pilotados por campeones, entre ellos Lewis Hamilton y el difunto brasileño Ayrton Senna, y uno de los cuales también fue probado por el actor de Hollywood Brad Pitt.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: McLaren va a poner a la venta cinco monoplazas de Fórmula 1 en perfecto estado de funcionamiento pilotados por campeones, entre ellos Lewis Hamilton y el difunto brasileño Ayrton Senna, y uno de los cuales también fue probado por el actor de Hollywood Brad Pitt. Los monoplazas, que se venderán a través del concesionario de lujo Tom Hartley Jr. y de los que se espera que recauden decenas de millones de dólares, serán puestos a punto por los actuales campeones de constructores para sus próximos propietarios. Hartley Jr. también vendió la colección del antiguo magnate de la F1 Bernie Ecclestone y 20 coches de carretera que pertenecían al fallecido copropietario de McLaren, Mansour Ojjeh. "Hemos decidido desprendernos de estos emblemáticos coches de Fórmula 1 de McLaren porque creemos que tenerlos simplemente guardados en un almacén es un flaco favor a lo que representan», declaró el domingo Zak Brown, director ejecutivo de McLaren Racing, en un comunicado. "Estos coches se fabricaron para ser conducidos y competir, y queremos que se utilicen y se disfruten. Creemos que esa es la mejor manera de mantener viva nuestra historia y activa nuestra actividad relacionada con el patrimonio".

item.title: La policía de Milán se enfrenta a los manifestantes en el segundo día de disturbios
item.description: La policía de Milán se enfrentó el domingo a manifestantes que lanzaban piedras y saqueaban tiendas durante las protestas contra la mala calidad de los servicios y el aumento del costo de la vida, un día después de que se produjeran disturbios similares en varias ciudades italianas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La policía de Milán se enfrentó el domingo a manifestantes que lanzaban piedras y saqueaban tiendas durante las protestas contra la mala calidad de los servicios y el aumento del costo de la vida, un día después de que se produjeran disturbios similares en varias ciudades italianas. La policía antidisturbios lanzó gases lacrimógenos y utilizó cañones de agua después de que varios cientos de manifestantes encapuchados rompieran escaparates y prendieran fuego a papeleras en la zona cercana a la céntrica Piazza Duomo, según informaron a Reuters fuentes conocedoras de la investigación. Más de 60 manifestantes fueron trasladados a la comisaría para ser sometidos a controles adicionales, añadieron las fuentes. Un total de 28 manifestantes fueron detenidos tras los enfrentamientos similares que estallaron el sábado en ciudades del norte, entre ellas Milán, Bolonia, Brescia, Bérgamo y Turín, según un reporte policial del domingo. Los enfrentamientos recordaron la violencia vivida en la vecina Francia, donde cientos de miles de personas, indignadas por el aumento de los precios y el deterioro de los servicios públicos, salieron a las calles el sábado en algunas de las protestas más violentas que se han vivido en el país en los últimos años. La primera ministra italiana, Giorgia Meloni, que se enfrenta a unas elecciones el año que viene, condenó la violencia y anunció una reunión del Gobierno el lunes para debatir cómo abordar la situación.

item.title: Anthropic destinará una participación del 5 % a un nuevo fondo de interés público
item.description: Anthropic anunció el domingo que destinará el 5 % de sus acciones a un nuevo fondo de interés público, siempre que los accionistas lo aprueben, y que dicha participación podría aumentar a medida que crezca la valoración del gigante de la inteligencia artificial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic anunció el domingo que destinará el 5 % de sus acciones a un nuevo fondo de interés público, siempre que los accionistas lo aprueben, y que dicha participación podría aumentar a medida que crezca la valoración del gigante de la inteligencia artificial. El fondo propuesto se constituiría como una sociedad de responsabilidad limitada de propiedad exclusiva y recibiría un 2 % adicional de las acciones de Anthropic, a discreción del consejo de administración, por cada aumento del 50 % en el valor de la empresa por encima de un umbral de referencia que aún no se ha revelado. El Fondo de Beneficio Público de Anthropic podría apoyar iniciativas como donaciones a organizaciones sin ánimo de lucro, distribuciones directas a poblaciones específicas e iniciativas para abordar el impacto de la IA en los trabajadores. La empresa ha afirmado que ninguna parte del capital social del fondo se utilizaría para actividades de cabildeo ni para contribuciones políticas, ni en Estados Unidos ni en el extranjero.
